text:
maria: Heads-up — canary comparing model_version=v2.3 -> v2.2 is showing a p99.9 token tail jump on /chat/generate. Dashboard: https://kibana.redwood/d/compare-mv-heatmap (look at 'per-token p99.9' overlay).

jason: I pulled the window. p50 ~same, p95 +5ms, p99.9 +120ms. Looks like the tail coincides with a KV miss burst.

kevin: Kernel-selection entropy also rises during the same window. Suspect: batchshape distribution caused more fallbacks to the continuous kernel. That path has higher per-token overhead for short sequences.

lucy: From the logs: lots of requests with batch_size=1 and seq_len<32 hit fallback. KV prefetch ratio drops ~30% concurrently. Flame link: https://flame.redwood/runtime/1998765432

canary-bot: canary summary: v2.3 @ 20% for 15m, error-rate stable, latency diff p99.9 = +120ms, kv_hit_rate delta = -0.28

maria: We don't have token-level labels that separate kernel_selected vs fallback vs kv_hit on the dashboard. Need more granular telemetry to attribute correctly.

jason: Proposal: emit per-token histogram metric with labels {route,model_version,kernel_selected,kv_hit}. Quick PromQL to derive p99.9 per-token (5m):

```
histogram_quantile(0.999, sum(rate(token_latency_seconds_bucket{route="/chat/generate",model_version=~"v2.*"}[5m])) by (le, model_version))
```

Then split by `kernel_selected` and `kv_hit` for attribution.

kevin: I'll add a gauge `kernel_selection_entropy{name=...,model_version=...}` so we can monitor drift in the selector heuristics. Also emitting `small_batch_fallback_ratio` = fallback_count / total_selection_count.

lucy: Add `kv_prefetch_ratio` and `kv_eviction_spike` boolean events. Also we should tag those metrics with `route` and `release_channel` so dashboards can isolate canary vs prod traffic.

maria: Action items: 
- kevin: implement entropy + fallback metrics and add labels to per-token histogram (ETA: PR today).
- jason: update the compare-MV dashboard with overlay panels for kernel vs kv attribution and an A/B diff panel (ETA: 2h).
- lucy: tune KV prefetch heuristics on the canary pool to see if hit ratio recovers; if not, rollback.

kevin: I'll open PR with code changes. Instrumentation will be opt-in behind env var `RUNTIME_TOKEN_LABELS` so we can roll without noise.

jason: Dashboard will include these panels: per-token p50/p95/p99/p99.9 by model_version; kernel-selection-entropy time series; small-batch-fallback_ratio heatmap (route x model_version); kv_prefetch_ratio per-host.

lucy: For the short term I'm going to scale the canary down to 10% and enable prefetchtune=v1 on the canary pool.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary weight reduced to 10% at 1998765460 by lucy

maria: Thanks — let's reconvene in 30 minutes after the PR and prefetchtune change are live. If p99.9 stays elevated, we'll rollback fully.

jason: I'll also add an automated alert: if per-token p99.9 delta between model_versions > 50ms for 3 consecutive 5m buckets, fire a page to eng-runtime oncall.

kevin: Noted. I'll include the alert rule in the PR.

lucy: FYI, I captured a short trace of a regressed request and pinned it in the dashboard (trace id: trace:0af3c1). It shows kernel fallback + kv miss in the same token boundary.

maria: Great find. OK — owners set. I'll drop a quick summary in the all-hands notes postmortem if this requires a rollback.

canary-bot: next update scheduled in 10m.

maria: tl;dr — instrumentation gap caused attribution ambiguity; immediate mitigations: reduce canary to 10%, enable kv prefetchtune, and add per-token labels + kernel entropy metric. Owners: kevin/jason/lucy.
